# chunk of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:chunkOf`](gmeow-chunkOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/chunkOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

The source information object this chunk segments. Functional: a chunk is cut from exactly one source; re-chunking produces new [`Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) individuals, never a re-pointed one.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:chunkOf`](gmeow-chunkOf.md) from [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
